summary: Tested public backend APIs and responsive frontend flows for Facilita AI. Backend regression suite passed all 4 tests; all ten tool pages and core navigation loaded. Confirmed QR preview defect and identified favorites/history synchronization gaps.

ui_bugs.issue: Entering a URL and clicking Gerar QR Code does not display the QR preview.
Favorite button is rendered with a no-op handler on the favorites screen, so users cannot remove a favorite there.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend favorites use localStorage only and never call the backend favorites routes; history screen is hardcoded empty and does not fetch /api/history. AI usage is recorded server-side, so these views do not reflect server data or account synchronization.

action_items: Fix QR tool state binding so entered URL controls qrcode-preview visibility/value.
Wire Favorites screen removal to the shared toggle/state handler.
Integrate authenticated favorites and history screens with /api/favorites and /api/history, including loading/error states.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolPage uses fields.topic to decide QR preview visibility, but the generic textarea handler writes qrcode input to fields.text; this makes the preview unreachable.
Favorites and history are currently presentation-only/local state despite backend persistence routes being available.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (ten tool pages, search, navigation, auth, utilities pass; QR and persistence integrations fail)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data; used the existing demo admin account and removed the test favorite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public mobile UI and backend were tested. Google OAuth is intentionally MOCKED as an explicit unconfigured state; ad is a labeled development placeholder. Recheck QR preview, favorites removal/sync, and history after fixes.
rca of the issue: QR reproduction: open /ferramenta/qrcode, enter https://facilita.ai, click Gerar QR Code; qrcode-preview remains absent because visibility checks fields.topic while the generic input handler updates fields.text for qrcode. Favorites/history RCA: useFavorites only reads/writes localStorage; Favorites passes an empty onFavorite handler and History always renders Empty, so backend persistence APIs are disconnected from the UI.
